note: Border is [left, bottom, right, top] in sheet pixels, matching UnityEditor.SpriteMetaData.border. Import as Sprite (2D and UI), Multiple, Mesh Type Full Rect, Alpha Is Transparency on, Filter Bilinear, Compression None, Pixels Per Unit 4.

sprites.name: Plate
sprites.usedBy: LetterpressButton plate and face, sheet buttons, the result slip body, feed art frames. Corner radius 2u.

sprites.name: PlateLine
sprites.usedBy: The outlined "Open the archive" button and the played play-button (1.5u keyline, radius 2u).

sprites.name: PlateHairline
sprites.usedBy: The result slip border and the how-to-play block (1u keyline, radius 2u).

sprites.name: StampFrame
sprites.usedBy: The rubber PLAY stamp struck on unplayed lead art (2.5u keyline, radius 3u). Rotate the RectTransform -8 degrees.

sprites.name: VerdictFrame
sprites.usedBy: The stamped verdict on the result slip (3u keyline, radius 3u). Rotate -4 degrees; scale-slam per Motion.VerdictStamp.

sprites.name: Field
sprites.usedBy: The archive search field and the game strip pause button (radius 8u).

sprites.name: Segment
sprites.usedBy: The settings theme segmented-control track (radius 6u).

sprites.name: SheetTop
sprites.usedBy: SheetFrame — the pause sheet chrome. Top corners 16u, bottom square, so it can sit flush on the safe-area edge.

sprites.name: Chip
sprites.usedBy: The archive filter chips and the segmented-control thumb (radius 4u).

sprites.name: Disc
sprites.usedBy: The played tick badge (18u), the toggle knob (22u), the how-to-play bullet and the staging pulse dot (5u). Simple mode, Preserve Aspect on.

sprites.name: Pill
sprites.usedBy: The dev-mode toggle track (46 x 28u). Fully round; never render it below 16u tall.

sprites.name: PillSmall
sprites.usedBy: The pause sheet grab handle (38 x 4u) and the launch overlay progress track and fill (3u). Never below 3u tall.

sprites.name: RuleDouble
sprites.usedBy: The double rule under a SectionHeader and over the slip kicker. Bands are 1u / 2u / 1u — stretch horizontally only, height fixed at 4u.

sprites.name: Fill
sprites.usedBy: Every square surface: hairlines, the masthead rule, the letterpress ledge, stat-band dividers, column rules, the overlay scrim, full-bleed grounds.

sprites.name: IconSearch
sprites.usedBy: Masthead action -> Archive.

sprites.name: IconSettings
sprites.usedBy: Masthead action -> Settings.

sprites.name: IconChevronLeft
sprites.usedBy: The back button, which names the screen beneath the top of the stack (UIPLAN 3.3).

sprites.name: IconChevronRight
sprites.usedBy: Archive row and settings row disclosure.

sprites.name: IconTick
sprites.usedBy: The played mark inside an 18u Disc — full opacity while the art behind it fades (UIPLAN 7.5).

sprites.name: IconClose
sprites.usedBy: Clears the archive search field.

sprites.name: IconPause
sprites.usedBy: The game strip pause glyph, in a 44u HitTarget (UIPLAN 10.7).

sprites.name: IconPlay
sprites.usedBy: "Next game" on the result slip.

sprites.name: IconSparkle
sprites.usedBy: "New best" on the result slip.
